# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately, through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/bl-ake/relucent/security/advisories/new),
and not in a public issue.

A useful report includes the relucent version, the steps or a minimal script that reproduces
the problem, and what an attacker could do with it.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made in the latest release only.
